summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Titan America SA, a foreign private issuer, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing discloses routine quarterly earnings, including revenue of $470.6 million (up 9.6% YoY), net income of $43.3 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $100.7 million. It discusses performance by segment, integration of the Keystone Cement acquisition (closed earlier, with synergies targeted at $30 million annual run-rate by 2029), and updated full-year outlook. No special-situation event (e.g., M&A announcement, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring) is initiated or disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic earnings report, not a special situation.
